purpose: The live scroll-progress percentage in the header. It lives in Header.jsx, NOT in Footer.jsx, so it is present on EVERY route including the 404.

props.id: progress - the element public/motion/m12.js writes to

states.rest: label.button at text.primary, updated every animation frame

notes: CORRECTION TO THE BUILD GROUNDWORK: #progress was described as living inside Footer, and therefore as absent from the 404. It does not. grep -rn 'id="progress"' src returns exactly one hit, src/components/Header.jsx:23, and Layout renders Header unconditionally on every route. Only #dotsField (src/components/Footer.jsx:85) is genuinely absent from the 404.
